title: 2023 HMMT November General Problem 6
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a square of side length 5. A circle passing through \(A\) is tangent to segment \(C D\) at \(T\) and meets \(A B\) and \(A D\) again at \(X \neq A\) and \(Y \neq A\), respectively. Given that \(X Y=6\), compute \(A T\).

solutions.text:
Let \(O\) be the center of the circle, and let \(Z\) be the foot from \(O\) to \(A D\). Since \(X Y\) is a diameter, \(O T=Z D=3\), so \(A Z=2\). Then \(O Z=\sqrt{5}\) and \(A T=\sqrt{O Z^{2}+25}=\sqrt{30}\).
